einzeiler: Pete Hegseth faces impeachment threats, a Florida bank shooting is stopped, and stocks…
kurzfassung: Secretary of War Pete Hegseth faces a growing bipartisan impeachment threat after devastating midterm losses. A Marine veteran working as a security guard successfully stops a deadly shooting at a Florida Citibank complex. Meanwhile, Wall Street experiences a sharp sell-off as post-election rallies come to an abrupt halt.
stichpunkte: Secretary of War Pete Hegseth faces mounting bipartisan impeachment pressure following midterm losses and backlash over the war in Iran.
House Republican Thomas Massey plans to force a privileged impeachment vote when Congress returns.
President Trump has privately discussed potential cabinet replacements, including Florida Governor Ron DeSantis.
An armed security guard and Marine veteran fatally shot an attacker who killed a Citibank employee in Brandon, Florida.
The Florida gunman, identified as Jacob Pearson, drove through a security fence following a dispute over a $2,500 debt.
Three convicted murderers faced executions across Indiana, Florida, and Alabama on the same day.
Wall Street indexes plunged, erasing post-election gains as concerns grew over state ballot measures restricting AI data centers.
The tech-heavy Nasdaq dropped 5.5% in its steepest one-day decline in 19 months, entering correction territory.

clips.hook: GOP lawmakers believe an impeachment vote against Pete Hegseth could pass
clips.text: Procedural rules could force a quick floor vote on impeachment, with some Republicans privately predicting the measure will succeed.

clips.hook: Uncertainty surrounds potential Senate appointments for cabinet members
clips.text: While a Senate seat vacancy in Tennessee sparked rumors about a cabinet member taking over, local sources dispute that possibility.

clips.hook: A security guard stopped a deadly office rampage in just four minutes
clips.text: The armed veteran engaged the attacker inside a restroom, ending the violent confrontation shortly after emergency calls began.

clips.hook: State leadership rejected final clemency requests prior to execution
clips.text: The governor declined intervention after multiple court reviews left a death sentence intact for a convicted murderer.

clips.hook: Major stock indexes suffered steep declines following election results
clips.text: The Nasdaq entered correction territory after recording its sharpest single-day drop in nearly two years.

beschreibung:
Secretary of War Pete Hegseth faces a growing bipartisan impeachment threat as President Trump reportedly considers replacing him following Republicans' devastating midterm losses. A Marine veteran working as a security guard fatally shoots a gunman who killed a Citibank employee at an office complex near Tampa, Florida, as investigators link the attack to a $2,500 debt. Indiana executes a man convicted of murdering two children, while Florida and Alabama prepare to carry out two additional executions on the same day amid renewed scrutiny of lethal injection procedures. Wall Street suffers a massive selloff that wipes out its post-election gains, with the Nasdaq plunging 5.5 percent as investors grow concerned about restrictions on data center development and the future of the AI boom.
